normative_scope: Complete assigned official multiplayer rules/all standard scenarios and firms, PLUS the explicitly attributed user-approved total defense strength >= attack interpretation. Crown/solo/two-player and optional setup draft excluded.
generic_policy: Correct iff every asked material fact is correct and supported, without a material contradiction. Partial for asked omission/abstention, Incorrect for a material wrong rule. No automatic grade cap from an overall source audit, unresolved unasked fixture or publication gate. Judge answers independently; evidence-only material cannot fill missing answer facts. Accept equivalent wording and clear contextual implications; do not require unasked key extras. Generic success-check rules need not be repeated for every office unless asked. Explicit false gameplay assertions remain material contradictions. Costs/actors/destinations/conditions actually requested are mandatory; recipient-only questions do not additionally require amounts.
